q: How does a footwear unit in Bahadurgarh work out CO2 per pair?
title: Bahadurgarh footwear CO2 per pair
short: Divide the unit's yearly electricity, DG diesel and any boiler fuel by pairs produced. Grid power at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh and diesel at 2.68 kg per litre cover most units. Export buyers often add materials such as soles and adhesives, which need supplier data.
audience: Footwear makers in Bahadurgarh and the NCR cluster

ul: Grid electricity for stitching, moulding and lasting.
Boiler or heater fuel if used for curing.

p: Divide by pairs produced in the same period.
Ask sole, upper and adhesive suppliers for their figures, or use labelled material factors.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
